authority.sourceDescription: Direct user-supplied completed-night review beginning 'What the house kept moving.'

findingDispositions.correction: Every narrated route names the source room, target room, and whether a selected message, presentation, or neither reached the target.
Opaque clusters were replaced by concrete nouns and operational verbs; broad seeded copy rejects the preserved terms.
Selected action, benefit, protected party, cost bearer, harm, self-cost, and stated risk are separate sourced sentences.
The summary selects one governing route and retains every selected last-resort event without stacking a second route chain.
The repeated evidence preamble and selected-action disclaimer were removed; every card now has one exact reason and one distinct limit.
A once-only key explains Selected action, Recorded effect, and Seen in scene while the typed model statuses remain intact.
Each canonical concept term now carries a nonempty plain subtitle of no more than six words.
The story, model limit and status key, and concept cards now use experiential, operative, and interpretive registers in separate semantic regions.

before.manualResult: The experiential and interpretive layers shared proof-register diction; causal depth and affected parties were present but obscured by abstraction and repeated qualification.

after.manualResult: No blocker-, high-, or medium-severity understandability defect remained in the final representative narrative or concept receipt.

adversarialPath.manualResult: No blocker-, high-, or medium-severity clarity defect remained after correcting action actuality, chronology, route content, affected-party wording, undefined handoff language, modeled exposure jargon, and the closing referent.

latticeAdvisory.acceptedNotice: RSR-RHY-001 and RSR-RHY-002 are duplicate cadence applications for uniformly brief narrative sentences. They are not a clarity defect and were not optimized mechanically.
